name: Dashlane
author: BoeyCorp
description: Dashlane password manager integration for the Omarchy status bar and quick access panel.

barWidget.description: Search logins, copy passwords & OTP codes, and manage your Dashlane vault directly from the bar.

schema.label: Auto-lock timeout (minutes)
schema.description: Lock vault automatically after minutes of inactivity (0 to disable)

schema.label: Lock when the screen locks
schema.description: Lock the vault as soon as the screen locks, instead of waiting out the auto-lock timeout. Uses the Omarchy lock screen's state.

schema.label: Lock when the machine suspends
schema.description: Lock the vault when the system goes to sleep, preventing decrypted credentials from persisting in memory.

schema.label: Clear clipboard timeout (seconds)
schema.description: Automatically clear copied password or OTP from clipboard after seconds (0 to disable)

schema.label: Auto-copy OTP delay (seconds)
schema.description: Automatically copy 2FA OTP code to clipboard shortly after copying password (0 to disable)

schema.label: Close panel on copy
schema.description: Automatically close panel after selecting and copying an item with Enter

schema.label: Colorize bar icon
schema.description: Use the active Omarchy theme accent for the primary bar icon.

schema.label: Contextual password suggestions
schema.description: Automatically match active window / browser tab to vault items on open
